name: Why Hookups are Scary & Dating is Painful - Stand Up Comedy By Kenny Sebastian
description:
Now that I am 33, I look back at my dating and hookup phase.

My advice? Wear full body hazmat suit and enjoy!

A small excerpt from my live show "Professor of Tomfoolery". 

Shot in Mumbai.
